1. (Currently Amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced __at least__ sixteen inches on center.

2. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __no more than__ twenty-four inches on center.

4. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

6. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening __in the housing__.

11. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover __that is removable__.

13. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall __constructed of wood or metal studs__.

15. (Currently Amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements __for securing the cooling system to the wall__; and a ventilation grill. 

17. (Currently Amended) A cooling system, comprising: a housing configured for mounting within a structure wall, a cooling system for evaporatively cooling an indoor area. 

18. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing includes __mounting brackets for securing the cooling system between wall studs spaced__ __at least__ sixteen inches on center.
